intro: East Coast Foam LLC helps homeowners, builders, and property owners improve comfort and energy performance with spray foam insulation, fiberglass, insulation removal, roofing foam, and protective coating services throughout the Lowcountry.
about: East Coast Foam LLC is locally owned and operated, serving Beaufort County, Charleston County, and surrounding Lowcountry communities. The team works with homeowners and builders to match insulation and coating solutions to the building, project goals, and coastal climate.

whyChoose.title: Experienced professionals
whyChoose.text: A knowledgeable insulation team focused on proper preparation, application, and project-specific recommendations.

whyChoose.title: Commitment to quality
whyChoose.text: East Coast Foam uses professional-grade materials from established manufacturers and focuses on durable, consistent installation.

whyChoose.title: Comprehensive services
whyChoose.text: From consultation and insulation removal through spray foam, fiberglass, roof foam, and protective coatings, customers can keep related work with one contractor.

whyChoose.title: Customer-focused approach
whyChoose.text: The team explains options, answers questions, and keeps communication direct from the first call through project completion.

whyChoose.title: Competitive value
whyChoose.text: Recommendations are built around the project rather than a one-size-fits-all product, with clear estimates before work begins.

whatToExpect.title: Free consultation
whatToExpect.text: Start with a conversation about the property, the problem you are trying to solve, and the scope of work.

whatToExpect.title: Site inspection
whatToExpect.text: East Coast Foam reviews the space and identifies conditions that may need attention before insulation or coating work begins.

whatToExpect.title: Professional installation
whatToExpect.text: The selected system is installed with attention to coverage, preparation, cleanliness, and the requirements of the building assembly.

whatToExpect.title: Completion review
whatToExpect.text: The finished work is reviewed with the customer and any important next steps, care information, or follow-up needs are discussed.
